Gimmick: Rolling Install: press U right after a special (costs 10%) to boost the next special: +1 hit, +20% damage, 2f faster (3 seconds). 5U rolls forward, 2U rolls back, j.U is a diving roll.
Prism Ring: 5U places a mid ring, 2U a low ring, j.U an angled ring. Your projectiles passing through it gain 1.5x speed, 1.5x size and +1 hit. One ring at a time, lasts 4s, 3s cooldown.
Apex Dash: 5U dashes diagonally up-forward, 2U up-back, j.U down-forward (can attack after 6f). 236L leaves a disc on the floor for okizeme.
Grip Shift: 5U armors mid/high hits, 2U armors low/mid hits (90f, every normal gets 1 armor hit, walks slower). j.U is an armored dive. 63214H command grab.
Grid Node: 5U places a node at your position, 2U on the floor 300px ahead, j.U in the air. Up to 3 nodes. 236L/M/H detonates node 1/2/3; with 2+ nodes a laser links them.
Elastic Stretch: U toggles stretch for 5s. Normals reach 1.6x farther with +3f recovery, and the hurtbox stretches too. 8s cooldown.
Puppet: hold U + direction to move Cylinder, hold U + L/M/H to make Cylinder attack, 2U recalls it, j.U makes it jump and strike. If Cylinder gets hit it is stunned for 3s.
STOP Parry: 5U parries high/mid, 2U parries low/mid, j.U parries in the air. 7f window; a successful parry stuns the attacker for 30f. Cannot parry throws or supers.

Stance (Narmaya style): U switches stance instantly, even mid-attack. Flat (blue): +20% reach, H normals get armor. Arc (pink): 1f faster startup, normals dash cancel, faster walk. Each stance has its own 4 specials.

Elements (Nine style): normals L=Fire, M=Ice, H=Lightning, gained on hit or block, up to 3. U casts a spell based on HOW MANY of each element you hold (19 spells). 214U stocks the spell; U with empty slots casts the stock.
